abilities.critical_failure: As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is paralyzed for 1 round as the haunt continues to tempt it.
abilities.critical_success: The creature sees through the illusion entirely and is temporarily immune to the haunt's routine for 1 minute.
abilities.effect: The haunt tempts nearby creatures to eat from the plates and bowls arrayed on the desk by concealing it in an illusion of food the viewer finds delicious. Each creature in area D5 must attempt a DC 21 Will save. The haunt then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: The creature believes the food is appetizing and becomes driven to consume it. The creature takes 4d4+4 slashing damage as it chews the jagged bones and husks.
abilities.name: Foul Temptation
abilities.success: The creature is not tempted by the food.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text:
This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to occult magic.

abilities.trigger: A creature looks over the contents of the desk

hazard.description: The former bank manager's ghostly presence tempts creatures to partake in a dubious meal.
hazard.disable: DC 18 Religion (trained) to say a prayer to Urgathoa and put the haunt temporarily to rest until it resets, DC 22 Occultism (trained) to commune with the bank manager's spirit and convince her to permanently pass on, disabling the haunt
hazard.name: Tylegmut's Last Meal
hazard.reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature eats a full meal at the desk—this can be any food, not just the “food” at hand.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The haunt sends a cloud of dust and bone shards hurtling about the room. The dust and bones batter all creatures in the room, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save). Creatures who fail the save are blinded for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
